text_block_list.text:
The cross-generational showdown was 
claimed by Silence Suzuka, who grew even 
faster and tore through the race like a 
whirlwind.

Having suffered defeat in the contest, El 
Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder swear their 
revenge, vowing to one day overtake 
Silence Suzuka.

Watching that match, Special Week felt a 
burning desire to surpass Silence Suzuka.

Silence Suzuka vows not to let Special 
Week overtake her... and sets her sights 
on the long-awaited Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
